description: Declarative Railway service map for Opero. Create services manually or via Railway CLI; do not auto-detect monorepo roots.

services.name: opero-web
services.notes: Bind WEB_HOST=0.0.0.0; use Railway $PORT as WEB_PORT. Set NEXT_PUBLIC_API_BASE_URL as a runtime service variable (not a Docker build-arg); include /api/v1 or the origin alone (normalized). Same image works for staging/production.

services.name: opero-api
services.notes: Private network to Postgres/Redis/S3. Korapay notification_url = https://<api-domain>/api/v1/billing/webhooks/korapay

services.name: opero-worker
services.notes: No public HTTP. Shares private network with API.

services.name: PostgreSQL
services.notes: Inject DATABASE_URL via Railway reference variables.

services.name: Redis
services.notes: Inject REDIS_HOST/PORT/PASSWORD or parse REDIS_URL in release.
